paths.name: Minimal correction
paths.mechanism: Patch the one failing parser branch and rerun its regression test

paths.name: Known-good replication
paths.mechanism: Rebuild the last passing release byte for byte and compare outputs

paths.name: Differential experiment
paths.mechanism: Run old and new parser on the same corpus and diff the results

paths.name: Instrumentation
paths.mechanism: Add counters at the queue boundary to observe drop rates directly

paths.name: Rollback
paths.mechanism: Restore the previous deploy and watch whether the error rate returns to baseline

paths.name: Containment
paths.mechanism: Route affected tenants to a read-only mode while the cause is found

paths.name: Alternate architecture
paths.mechanism: Replace the shared cache with per-worker caches to remove contention

paths.name: Dependency substitution
paths.mechanism: Swap the serializer library for the standard one and compare behaviour

paths.name: Independent reproduction
paths.mechanism: Ask a second operator on separate hardware to reproduce from the report alone

paths.name: Staged rollout
paths.mechanism: Ship to one percent of traffic with automatic halt on the error budget

paths.name: Defer pending evidence
paths.mechanism: Wait for the weekly batch that exercises the rare input before deciding

paths.name: Stop and take no action
paths.mechanism: Accept the current rate because its cost is below the fix's risk

paths.name: Escalate to domain authority
paths.mechanism: Hand the timing question to the network owner who controls the link

paths.name: Load test
paths.mechanism: Replay peak traffic in staging to see whether failures scale with load

paths.name: Configuration audit
paths.mechanism: Diff live settings against the pinned baseline to find drift

paths.name: Fault injection
paths.mechanism: Kill the primary during writes to test the failover path deliberately

paths.name: Bisect history
paths.mechanism: Binary-search commits between good and bad builds to find the change

paths.name: User interview
paths.mechanism: Ask the three reporting users what they did just before the failure

paths.name: Formal model
paths.mechanism: Write a small state-machine model of the retry logic and check its invariants

paths.name: Retire the feature
paths.mechanism: Remove the rarely used export path that triggers the failure
